publicRelease.body:
## ChainlessChain v5.0.3.144

Released with CLI **0.166.139**, Open VSX **0.37.175**, and publicly approved JetBrains **0.4.192**. All five platform producers and the exact-source required checks passed. [Verified build workflow](https://github.com/chainlesschain/chainlesschain/actions/runs/41542995529). Source: `7be0ebbcd9c9e1b52151f32e7229f6868ce320c7`.

Desktop distribution: Windows/macOS packages are unsigned; macOS is not notarized. The iOS IPA is signed for Ad Hoc distribution to registered devices; this release does not publish to App Store or Google Play.

### Installation

Download the appropriate file for your platform:

#### Windows
- `ChainlessChain-Setup-5.0.3-alpha.144.exe` - Installer (recommended)
- `ChainlessChain-Portable-5.0.3-alpha.144.exe` - Portable version (run directly, no install)

#### macOS
- `ChainlessChain-5.0.3-alpha.144.dmg` - Intel Mac (open and drag to /Applications)
- `ChainlessChain-5.0.3-alpha.144-arm64.dmg` - Apple Silicon (open and drag to /Applications)

#### Linux
- `ChainlessChain-5.0.3-alpha.144.AppImage` - Universal Linux package
- `chainlesschain-desktop-vue_5.0.3-alpha.144_amd64.deb` - Debian/Ubuntu package
- `chainlesschain-desktop-vue-5.0.3-alpha.144.x86_64.rpm` - Fedora/RHEL package

#### Android
- `app-arm64-v8a-release.apk` - Modern 64-bit devices (recommended)
- `app-armeabi-v7a-release.apk` - Older 32-bit devices
- `app-universal-release.apk` - All architectures (larger, direct install)
- `app-release.aab` - Android App Bundle (Google Play Store)

#### iOS
- `ChainlessChain.ipa` - iOS App (Ad-hoc distribution, signed builds only)

### System Requirements

- **Windows**: Windows 10/11 (x64)
- **macOS**: macOS 12+ (Intel & Apple Silicon)
- **Linux**: Ubuntu 20.04+ / Fedora 34+ / Arch Linux (x64)
- **Android**: Android 8.0 (API 26) or higher
- **iOS**: iOS 15.0+ (iPhone/iPad)

### Notes

- U-Key hardware integration is Windows-only
- Backend services can run via Docker or bundled binaries
- First launch may take longer as services initialize

### Verification

All binaries are built via GitHub Actions and can be verified against the workflow runs.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/chainlesschain/chainlesschain/compare/v5.0.3.142...v5.0.3.144
